description: This bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of two models, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across different query complexities: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The horizontal axis represents the query complexity categories labeled “Simple”, “Moderate”, “Challenging”, and “Total”, appearing in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Execution Accuracy”, displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick labels at 10-unit intervals. For each complexity category, there are two bars representing the models: NatSQL is light gray and TA-SQL is blue. For the “Simple” category, NatSQL has a height of approximately 48.60, while TA-SQL reaches 63.14. In the “Moderate” category, NatSQL’s height is around 36.11, and TA-SQL reaches 51.35. For “Challenging” queries, NatSQL’s height is approximately 32.32, and TA-SQL reaches 56.19. Finally, for the “Total” accuracy, NatSQL is at 48.60 and TA-SQL is at 56.19. The bars are arranged side-by-side for each complexity category, allowing for a visual comparison of the two models within each category, and are not sorted in any particular order based on height or model name.
